tags.mechanism: Amazon radioactivity linked to rare-earth mining activities; supply-chain or regulatory risks elevate strategic materials scarcity concerns.

items.note: Russian government grain interventions signal efforts to stabilize domestic prices, likely increasing export supply and weighing on global wheat.

items.headline: Hormuz disruption cuts Qatar LNG exports by 96 %
items.note: Severe LNG export disruption tightens global energy supply, pushing TTF prices higher and triggering risk-off sentiment across markets.

tags.mechanism: Hormuz disruption cutting Qatar LNG exports by 96% reduces global LNG supply; European TTF gas prices rise due to supply shock.
Geopolitical disruption and energy crisis concerns drive risk-off sentiment.
